title: A markdown image/link data-exfiltration payload is flagged
what: A note body hides a data-exfiltration vector in a markdown image whose URL carries the smuggled data. A renderer that auto-loads the image leaks it. The linter holds such a note in quarantine (GAP-POISON-MDLINK, fixed).

expect.desc: the markdown exfiltration payload should be held or refused
and should not be served as ordinary memory
